name: Sorn Orlith
backstory:
Hailing from the Underdark, Sorn was originally employed as a courtesan, and Nym as an artisanal masseuse. The pair fled the Underdark due to the matriarchy's mistreatment of men, ultimately coming to work in Baldur's Gate. Sorn seems to thoroughly enjoy his line of work, particularly fulfilling extreme and interesting fantasies; he remarks that Drow culture is obsessed with bondage, which became boring.

A Lolth-sworn Tav or Dark Urge can question the validity of their claims about their background by pointing out that Sorn and Nym are Seldarine Drow.
